why: Archive manifest demands regular executable but venv interpreter aliases are excluded; generated console scripts reference temporary build paths. ScrapeGraphAI has no console script. No invented application command or ambient PATH can solve this.

entrypoint.source: Copy exact executable bytes only from current held official PM Python3.14 receipt, preserving reviewed executable mode and recording actual SHA/size/source receipt. No system Python, arbitrary binary or downloaded substitute. Base PM stdlib/runtime/dependency closure remains separately retained current prerequisite.
entrypoint.manifest: Entry point is environment interpreter, not invented app CLI or success proof. Archive member SHA/mode/size must equal observed PM executable. Root materializer verifies extracted bytes and held final inode/mode/owner/tree; fixed probe recipe executes exact final interpreter with -I and reviewed probe source. pyvenv.cfg base runtime references must match held PM runtime selection, never ambient/system path. No symlink flattening or external alias treated as regular archive file.

console_scripts.rule: Exact wheel entry_points.txt and pinned source metadata jointly define script name/module/function; no names or callable inferred. Only these source-reviewed names may use the finite relocation path. Absent scripts are not an error for interpreter-based qualification. Additional scripts require source review before execution.
console_scripts.materializer: RootApplicationRuntimeEnvironmentMaterializer.normalize_selected_python_entrypoints(runtime_preparation_selection_handle,archive_receipt_handle)->RootApplicationRuntimeRelocationReceipt. It obtains final root-owned immutable generation directory from retained setup/runtime root selection, never caller path. Before final tree publication, verify actual generated console script format/callable against exact wheel/source entrypoint, original shebang interpreter is exact selected temporary build interpreter, and rewrite ONLY that shebang to exact held final environment/bin/python3.14 path. Preserve remaining bytes and mode; reject unexpected shell wrappers/format/callable, path chars incompatible shebang or >platform shebang limit. No /usr/bin/env, shell or PATH dependency. Do not run script during rewrite.
console_scripts.digest: Final installed manifest/digest computed AFTER actual copy/extraction/normalization, never required before build. Receipt joins original archive and complete original member manifest plus exact final installed tree; runtime/probe receipts consume final tree, not archive hash alone. Root-owned final generation path is fixed from current retained root selection before publication; digest not used to fabricate preknown path/tree. Failed normalization preserves pending/unusable environment and owned cleanup.

tasks.work: Use held PM executable as regular environment entrypoint and exact source-console-script shebang normalization to held final generation; record original/final members and run fixed ABI/import probe with final interpreter. No CLI assumed for ScrapeGraphAI.

acceptance: Source-selected recipe correction only; no installed environment, full closure/native ARM64 or app qualification acceptance. All AC open; baseline unchanged.
